#### Clase `BufferedByteReceiveStream` (Línea 31)
- **Docstring:** _Wraps any bytes-based receive stream and uses a buffer to provide sophisticated
receiving capabilities in the form of a byte stream._
- **Métodos:**
  - `def aclose(self)` (Línea 41): Sin docstring.
  - `def buffer(self)` (Línea 46): The bytes currently in the buffer.
  - `def extra_attributes(self)` (Línea 51): Sin docstring.
  - `def feed_data()` (Línea 54): Append data directly into the buffer.

Any data in the buffer will be consumed by receive operations before receiving
anything from the wrapped stream.

:param data: the data to append to the buffer (can be bytes or anything else
    that supports ``__index__()``)
  - `def receive(self, max_bytes)` (Línea 67): Sin docstring.
  - `def receive_exactly(self, nbytes)` (Línea 88): Read exactly the given amount of bytes from the stream.

:param nbytes: the number of bytes to read
:return: the bytes read
:raises ~anyio.IncompleteRead: if the stream was closed before the requested
    amount of bytes could be read from the stream
  - `def receive_until(self, delimiter, max_bytes)` (Línea 115): Read from the stream until the delimiter is found or max_bytes have been read.

:param delimiter: the marker to look for in the stream
:param max_bytes: maximum number of bytes that will be read before raising
    :exc:`~anyio.DelimiterNotFound`
:return: the bytes read (not including the delimiter)
:raises ~anyio.IncompleteRead: if the stream was closed before the delimiter
    was found
:raises ~anyio.DelimiterNotFound: if the delimiter is not found within the
    bytes read up to the maximum allowed

#### Clase `BufferedConnectable` (Línea 177)
- **Docstring:** _Wraps a byte stream connectable to produce :class:`BufferedByteStream` connections.

Use this when you want the streams returned by :meth:`connect` to have the buffered
receive API (e.g. :meth:`~BufferedByteReceiveStream.receive_exactly` and
:meth:`~BufferedByteReceiveStream.receive_until`).

:param connectable: the byte stream connectable to wrap_
